title: Deck builder copy-limit affordance: alias spellings counted separately, search-add ungated
scope: Deck-builder copy-limit affordance (client subsystem): real useDeckBuilder hook via vitest/jsdom on client code at the v0.113.0 release commit; engine canonicalization leg replicated against pinned v0.113.0 card data
result: Both reported gaps reproduce on v0.113.0. Gap 1: text-imported 5x 'Nazgul' + 4x 'Nazgûl' stay as separate entries; canIncrement true for both at canonical 9/9 (the engine merges them to 'nazgûl', ceiling UpTo(9)); handleIncrementCard('Nazgul') climbs to canonical 10 > 9. Gap 2: with 4x Lightning Bolt at ceiling (canIncrement false), a 5th handleAddCard (the search-result add path) walks 4 -> 5 without consulting canIncrement. Control: handleIncrementCard at 5 Bolts is a no-op (the #6654 gate holds).
limitations: UI-subsystem test: real hook via vitest/jsdom, not a full browser session; no game-state pair exists for a deckbuilder report.

engineRuntime.maxDeckCopies mocked per name to the real engine-resolved values; the WASM engine bundle is not shipped in the checkout, so ceiling resolution itself is not executed. Engine leg corroborates the mock against pinned v0.113.0 card data.

Engine canonicalization leg replicates the engine's documented algorithm against pinned card data (engine not compiled on this host); deck_validation.rs + card_db.rs byte-identical v0.112.0..v0.113.0.
Browser UI not exercised; the correct fix shape for gap 2 (disabled tile vs silent no-op) is a design decision, not asserted.
